---
title: "Pricing game debrief"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 2
    fig-width: 9
    fig-height: 5.5
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  warning: false
  message: false
params:
  db: "data/pricing_game.sqlite"   # live SQLite file …
  session_id: null                 # … and which session (null = most recent scored)
  bundle_dir: null                 # …OR an unzipped export bundle instead of the DB
  figs_dir: "figs"                 # PNGs are also written here for slide decks
  anon: false                      # label firms "Firm A/B" instead of names
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(ggplot2)
# Run this from the project root (it reuses the app's own plotting code, so the
# report and the on-platform Debrief tab can't disagree).
source("R/load_engine.R"); source_engine()
source("R/db.R")
source("R/session_logic.R")
source("R/debrief_data.R")
source("R/debrief_plots.R")

if (!is.null(params$bundle_dir)) {
  d <- dbf_load_bundle(params$bundle_dir, params$session_id)
} else {
  con <- db_connect(params$db)
  sid <- params$session_id
  if (is.null(sid)) {
    s <- sl_list_sessions(con); s <- s[s$n_result_rows > 0, ]
    stopifnot("no scored sessions in the database" = nrow(s) > 0)
    sid <- s$session_id[1]
  }
  d <- dbf_load(con, sid)
}

dir.create(params$figs_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
save_fig <- function(name, plot, w = 9, h = 5.5) {
  dev <- if (requireNamespace("ragg", quietly = TRUE)) ragg::agg_png else grDevices::png
  ggsave(file.path(params$figs_dir, paste0(name, ".png")), plot,
         device = dev, width = w, height = h, dpi = 200)
  plot
}
lb    <- dbf_leaderboards(d)
fr    <- dbf_flags(d)
preds <- dbf_predictions(d)
```

# `r d$game$label`

```{r game-params}
b <- d$benchmarks; p <- d$params
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  Parameter = c("Model", "Rounds", "NE price", "Collusive price", "Monopoly (textbook)"),
  Value = c(d$model, d$session$n_rounds,
            paste0("$", round(b$ne)), paste0("$", round(b$collusive)),
            paste0("$", round(b$monopoly)))))
```

# Price paths

```{r price-paths}
save_fig("price_paths", plot_price_paths(d, anon = params$anon))
```

# Average price per round

```{r avg-price}
save_fig("average_price", plot_avg_price(d), h = 4.5)
```

# Cumulative profit

```{r cum-profit}
save_fig("cumulative_profit", plot_profit_paths(d, anon = params$anon))
```

# Leaderboards

```{r leaderboards}
knitr::kable(transform(lb$individuals,
  total_profit = round(total_profit), vs_ne = round(vs_ne),
  vs_collusive = round(vs_collusive)),
  caption = "Players — total profit, vs. both firms playing NE every round, and vs. both firms colluding every round")
knitr::kable(transform(lb$markets, market_profit = round(market_profit)),
  caption = "Markets — combined profit")
```

```{r predictions}
#| eval: !expr length(preds) > 0
#| fig-height: 7
#| output: asis
cat("\n# Predictions vs. what happened\n\n")
print(save_fig("predictions", plot_predictions_grid(preds), h = 7))
knitr::kable(dbf_prediction_table(d), caption = "Each student's predictions, their actual round-1 price, and final profit")
```

# Teachable moments

```{r flags-table}
if (nrow(fr)) {
  ft <- fr[c("kind", "market_id", "round", "detail", "rationale")]
  names(ft) <- c("kind", "market", "round", "what happened", "why they said")
  knitr::kable(ft)
} else cat("Nothing flagged for this session.\n")
```

```{r flags-figs}
#| results: asis
#| fig-height: 4.5
panels <- fr[fr$firm_label %in% c("Firm A", "Firm B"), , drop = FALSE]
for (i in seq_len(nrow(panels))) {
  cat("\n\n## ", panels$kind[i], " — Market ", panels$market_id[i],
      ", round ", panels$round[i], "\n\n", sep = "")
  if (nzchar(panels$rationale[i]))
    cat("> ", panels$who[i], " said: *", panels$rationale[i], "*\n\n", sep = "")
  pl <- plot_best_response(d, panels$market_id[i], panels$round[i], panels$firm_label[i])
  print(save_fig(sprintf("best_response_m%s_r%s", panels$market_id[i], panels$round[i]),
                 pl, h = 4.5))
}
```
